{{Top}}
An '''tax stamp''' was, presumably, a kind of adhesive [[Paper/Legends|paper]] mark certifying payment of certain taxes in the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. At the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the bombardment of [[Dankayo/Legends|Dankayo]], the audience chamber of [[Squib/Legends|Squib]] king [[Ebareebaveebeedee]] on his [[momship]] ''[[Thrifty]]'' was decorated with an enormous mural made of multihued tax stamps. The stamps bore the warning "Do Not Remove Under Penalty of [[Death/Legends|Death]]".
